headline: Space Force backs startup seeking to change how satellites move in orbit
summary: Space Force backs startup seeking to change how satellites move in orbit
Pixxel raises $100 million to expand satellite production across India and US

global.title: Space Force backs startup seeking to change how satellites move in orbit
global.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Space Force is putting $50 million behind a startup developing an unusual way to dispatch small spacecraft from a larger vehicle in orbit.
global.why: Kept so the editor has a record of what was reported, not because a full desk sweep was done.

global.title: Pixxel raises $100 million to expand satellite production across India and US
global.summary: TAMPA, Fla. — Indian hyperspectral imaging startup Pixxel announced a $100 million funding round Sept. 6 to ramp up satellite production, including in the United States as it pursues more government business.
